title: Brown carbon is a significant contributor to aerosol climate forcing in the northwestern Himalayas
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00140H, Paper
Rahul Kant Yadav, Aditi Rana, Rajdeep Singh, Harish C. Phuleria, Sayantan Sarkar
Brown carbon aerosols emitted from fossil fuel combustion and biomass burning sources in the regional vicinity are atmospherically transported to the northwestern Himalayas, leading to significant climate forcing.
